hero.headline: No one left
hero.lead: Kancara is a group travel planner that takes every member's needs into account, from planning to the trip home.

pass.originNote: The plan follows whoever speaks up the most.
pass.destinationNote: A plan that fits each person.

problem.title: Usually, the plan follows the loudest voice.
problem.body: The member who uses a wheelchair, the parent with a toddler, the friend on a tight budget, or the one with dietary restrictions ends up giving way. Sometimes they just stay home.
problem.answer: Kancara turns the order around. Each member's needs go down first, and the plan is built from them.

principles.title: What we hold to
principles.lead: Four things we measure against every time we add something to Kancara.

items.title: Every member counts
items.body: A need someone states has to show up in the plan, not just get stored.

items.title: One minute to start
items.body: The first step asks for as little as possible from you.

items.title: Honest about state
items.body: Sample data, loading, and failures are always labelled for what they are.

items.title: For one person or many
items.body: Nothing in the flow assumes a fixed group size.

status.title: Kancara is young, and we're open about it.
status.body: Kancara was born this year out of frustration with holiday plans that always leave someone out. We're just getting started, so here is what you can use today and what we're still working on.
now: A boarding pass to check the plan
A day-by-day itinerary that checks each need
next: Access without a signal during the trip

cta.title: Ready to set off with your group?
cta.body: Tell Captain about your trip. We'll help put the rest together.
